gen-gf-gabarito-gf-brygada-1918: Brygada 1918 is a dignified serif whose mild swelling recalls a worn felt marker, while Gabarito's open-cut terminals keep the headings flowing. Size the body text a touch generously.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cactus-classical-seri: Cactus Classical Serif brings an authoritative, classic serif voice, its e opened wide and its bowls shifting gently in weight. And Gabarito, with no stroke contrast whatsoever, hums along above it like a bent wire.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-caudex: Bent-paperclip headings, then a bookish turn. Gabarito draws everything without thick-thin shifts, while Caudex answers with gaping e mouths and slight pressure changes. Gabarito earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Outlines in one width, then brushed watercolor. Gabarito's single-nib headings meet Chiron Sung HK, a text serif whose weight shifts quietly and whose round forms end in wide-set curves, so the pairing feels like a drawn sign beside an editorial page.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cinzel: Expressive and flat-drawn up top, with no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye. Cinzel sits next to it as a text serif with lighter horizontals, loosely tracked and generous with space, so the two feel like friendly rivals.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-diphylleia: Gabarito draws its letters with no modulation at all, each terminal cut open so the counters flow outward. Diphylleia, a bookish serif, gives curves a little more weight than joins, and keeps its apertures open at tiny sizes.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-donegal-one: Donegal One is refined and authoritative. Its curves leave daylight like a rope's open bight, and its thin strokes never turn spindly, which lets a classic serif carry a longer stretch comfortably while Gabarito's constant-stroke headings stay bold above it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-fjord-one: Expressive and distinctive, Gabarito runs monoline strokes throughout with terminals cut open so counters flow outward. Fjord One, a text serif with wide-mouthed rounds, thins its joins gently, and that gap is the whole charm.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gentium-book-plus: Gentium Book Plus has horizontals a notch lighter than its uprights. Its wide letter openings sit like a door left ajar, a classic serif of low-key thick-thin variation under Gabarito's technical-pen headings, which is where the pair's charm lives.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gfs-didot: GFS Didot reads literary and quiet, with subtle stroke modulation and generous curves. Gabarito's flat, stencil-cut headings of single weight sit above this classic serif, so the page moves from bold simplicity to refined texture.
